name: Earth-616
label: MCU
description: The primary Marvel Cinematic Universe timeline, encompassing the interconnected stories of Phase 1 through Phase 6 and beyond.

name: Fox X-Men Universe
label: Legacy
description: The X-Men film series produced by 20th Century Fox, featuring mutants like Wolverine, Professor X, and Magneto in a separate cinematic continuity.

name: Raimi Spider-Man Universe
label: Legacy
description: Sam Raimi's Spider-Man trilogy starring Tobey Maguire, which established the modern superhero movie template in the early 2000s.

name: Amazing Spider-Man Universe
label: Legacy
description: The Marc Webb-directed Spider-Man films starring Andrew Garfield, presenting a different take on Peter Parker's story.

name: Sony's Spider-Man Universe
label: Legacy
description: Sony's Spider-Man adjacent films featuring characters like Venom, Morbius, and Kraven the Hunter, existing in a separate universe from the MCU.

name: Marvel Animated Multiverse
label: Animated
description: The animated stories explored in Marvel's What If...? series, showcasing alternate outcomes and branching timelines from key MCU events.

name: Netflix Defenders Universe
label: Legacy
description: The Marvel Television series produced for Netflix, including Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, Iron Fist, and The Defenders.
